title: Canvas execution input revision boundary — IMPLEMENTED
description: Additive acceptance semantics for existing expectedRevision on opt-in single-node managed CANVAS/MEDIA execution. Snapshot PUT retains full-project If-Match CAS. Private database revision evidence is never supplied by clients or returned in graph JSON.

x-acceptance-invariant.inputs: Requested and current complete CanvasGuard must match exactly. Every present target/input-closure node must have last_changed_project_revision <= expectedRevision.
x-acceptance-invariant.ordering: Private last_node_order_changed_revision <= expectedRevision. Reordering existing nodes, including a subsequent undo, conservatively invalidates older receipts project-wide; unrelated node additions/deletions preserve survivor order.
x-acceptance-invariant.consumption: A successful managed task claim stamps its target at the acceptance revision without changing its input version; another new task cannot reuse a receipt from before that claim. Existing idempotent task replay retains its existing authorization checks.
x-acceptance-invariant.unchanged: Authentication, project permissions, leases, history/asset authorization, snapshot CAS, lifecycle versions and result-writeback guards remain required.
